paragraphs.s: G keen

paragraphs.s: Sonia doesn't …………… going abroad because she isn't …………… on travelling long distances and she really can't …………… flying.
paragraphs.tr: Sonia 不想出国，因为她不喜欢长途旅行，而且她实在受不了坐飞机。

ana.frame: 否定谓语 + 原因从句：Sonia doesn't ____ going abroad because she isn't ____ on travelling long distances and she really can't ____ flying.
parts: doesn't …………… going abroad —— 不想出国（fancy doing）
because she isn't …………… on travelling long distances —— 因为不喜欢长途旅行（be keen on）
and she really can't …………… flying —— 而且受不了坐飞机（can't stand）
clauses: because 引导原因状语从句
三个空后面分别是 doing / on / doing
gram: fancy doing sth 想做某事
can't stand doing sth 无法忍受
ana.tip: 看空后的形式：going → fancy doing；on → be keen on；flying → can't stand doing。官方：1 fancy / 2 keen / 3 stand。

paragraphs.s: She would …………… to have a holiday near her home and she'd …………… go camping than stay in a hotel.
paragraphs.tr: 她更愿意在离家近的地方度假，而且她宁愿去露营也不愿住酒店。

ana.frame: 并列谓语：She would ____ to have a holiday … and she'd ____ go camping than stay in a hotel.
parts: would …………… to have a holiday near her home —— 更愿意在离家近的地方度假（prefer to do）
she'd …………… go camping than stay in a hotel —— 宁愿露营也不住酒店（would rather do … than do）
clauses: would rather do A than do B 宁愿做 A 也不做 B
gram: prefer to do sth 更喜欢
would rather do sth 宁愿
ana.tip: 空后有 to → prefer to；后面是 go 原形 + than → would rather。官方：4 prefer / 5 rather。

paragraphs.s: She's …………… of nature and really doesn't …………… if it rains a lot!
paragraphs.tr: 她喜欢大自然，而且真的不介意经常下雨！

ana.frame: 系表 + 并列谓语：She's ____ of nature and really doesn't ____ if it rains a lot!
parts: …………… of nature —— 喜欢大自然（be fond of）
doesn't …………… if it rains a lot —— 不介意下很多雨（don't mind if…）
clauses: if 引导宾语从句（介意什么）
ana.tip: of → be fond of；「不介意」→ don't mind。官方：6 fond / 7 mind。

paragraphs.s: ② Work in pairs. Which of the words in Exercise 1 do we use for something we:

ana.frame: 祈使句 + 疑问句：Work in pairs. Which of the words … do we use for something we: …
parts: Work in pairs —— 两人一组活动
Which of the words in Exercise 1 do we use —— 我们用练习 1 里的哪些词
for something we: —— 用来表达我们对某事物的（感受）
clauses: Which of … 哪些
ana.tip: 下面四组感受各对应哪些词？一组可以不止一个词。

ana.frame: 分组：a like?（喜欢）
ana.tip: 官方答案：fancy、keen (on)、fond (of)。

paragraphs.s: b prefer?
paragraphs.tr: b 更喜欢？

ana.frame: 分组：b prefer?（更喜欢）
ana.tip: 官方答案：rather（would rather 宁愿）。

paragraphs.s: c dislike?
paragraphs.tr: c 不喜欢？

ana.frame: 分组：c dislike?（不喜欢）
ana.tip: 官方答案：(can't) stand（无法忍受）。

paragraphs.s: d don't think is important?
paragraphs.tr: d 觉得不重要？

ana.frame: 分组：d don't think is important?（觉得不重要）

ana.tip: 官方答案：(don't) mind（不介意 = 觉得不重要）。

paragraphs.s: B1 Preliminary candidates often make mistakes with words that express likes and dislikes.
paragraphs.tr: B1 Preliminary 的考生经常在表达「喜欢和不喜欢」的词上出错。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：B1 Preliminary candidates often make mistakes with words …
parts: B1 Preliminary candidates —— B1 Preliminary 的考生
with words that express likes and dislikes —— 在表达喜欢和不喜欢的词上
clauses: that 引导定语从句
gram: make mistakes with 在……上出错
ana.tip: likes and dislikes（喜欢与不喜欢）是 Part 2 的常见话题。

paragraphs.s: FOCUS: IDENTIFYING LIKES, DISLIKES AND PREFERENCES
paragraphs.tr: 重点：识别喜欢、不喜欢和偏好。

ana.frame: 小标题：FOCUS: IDENTIFYING LIKES, DISLIKES AND PREFERENCES
parts: LIKES, DISLIKES AND PREFERENCES —— 喜欢、不喜欢和偏好
ana.tip: 人物文本里，喜欢/不喜欢/宁愿的词就是匹配的钥匙。

paragraphs.s: ③ Read this description of someone who wants to go to a sports centre. Underline the key expressions and the words that tell you what he likes and prefers.
paragraphs.tr: ③ 读这段描述（他想去体育中心）。划出关键表达和告诉你他喜欢什么、偏好什么的词。

ana.frame: 祈使句：Read this description … Underline the key expressions and the words …
parts: Read this description of someone who wants to go to a sports centre —— 读这段想去体育中心的人物的描述
Underline the key expressions —— 划出关键表达
and the words that tell you what he likes and prefers —— 以及告诉你他喜欢和偏好的词
clauses: who 引导定语从句
what 引导宾语从句
ana.tip: 划出的词就是我们配对时的「关键词」。

paragraphs.s: Ethan wants to train every day
paragraphs.tr: Ethan 想每天训练。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：Ethan wants to train every day
clauses: want to do sth 想做某事
ana.tip: 划出 every day —— 对应「每天开放」的场馆。

paragraphs.s: and he doesn't mind paying a regular amount to stay fit.
paragraphs.tr: 而且他不介意定期付一笔钱来保持健康。

ana.frame: 并列谓语：and he doesn't mind paying a regular amount to stay fit.
parts: a regular amount —— 一笔定期的费用
to stay fit —— 为了保持健康
clauses: mind doing sth 介意做某事
gram: a regular amount 一笔定期的钱
ana.tip: 划出 doesn't mind —— 对应「会员费」这种定期付费。

paragraphs.s: He fancies learning a new sport
paragraphs.tr: 他想学一项新运动。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：He fancies learning a new sport
parts: learning a new sport —— 学一项新运动
clauses: fancy doing sth 想做某事
ana.tip: 划出 fancies —— 对应「有课程可学」的场馆。

paragraphs.s: and prefers to make reservations by email.
paragraphs.tr: 而且更喜欢用电子邮件预订。

ana.frame: 并列谓语：and prefers to make reservations by email.
clauses: prefer to do sth 更喜欢做某事
ana.tip: 划出 prefers —— 对应「可在线预订」的场馆。

paragraphs.s: FOCUS: MATCHING KEYWORDS WITH PARAPHRASES
paragraphs.tr: 重点：把关键词和同义改写匹配起来。

ana.frame: 小标题：FOCUS: MATCHING KEYWORDS WITH PARAPHRASES
parts: KEYWORDS WITH PARAPHRASES —— 关键词与同义改写
gram: paraphrase 同义改写、换一种说法
ana.tip: 文本里很少出现和人物描述一模一样的词 —— 找「换了一种说法」的地方。

paragraphs.s: ④ Read these descriptions of three sports centres and decide which of A-C would be the most suitable for Ethan. Then say why that is the correct answer.
paragraphs.tr: ④ 读这三家体育中心的介绍，判断 A–C 中哪一家最适合 Ethan，然后说说为什么那才是正确答案。

ana.frame: 祈使句：Read these descriptions … and decide which of A-C would be the most suitable for Ethan.
parts: Read these descriptions of three sports centres —— 读三家体育中心的介绍
and decide which of A-C would be the most suitable for Ethan —— 判断 A–C 哪家最适合 Ethan
Then say why that is the correct answer —— 再说说为什么
clauses: which 引导宾语从句；would 表推测
ana.tip: 把 Ethan 的四个需求逐条对到场馆文本上。

paragraphs.s: We don't charge much: just a £3 entrance fee (free for students).
paragraphs.tr: 我们收费不高：门票只要 3 英镑（学生免费）。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：We don't charge much: just a £3 entrance fee …
parts: just a £3 entrance fee (free for students) —— 门票只要 3 英镑（学生免费）
ana.tip: 价格便宜 ≠ Ethan 的需求（他更在意设施和预订方式）。

paragraphs.s: In summer, relax in our outdoor pool or walk around our beautiful gardens.
paragraphs.tr: 夏天可以在我们的露天泳池放松，或者在我们美丽的花园里散步。

ana.frame: 祈使句：relax in our outdoor pool or walk around our beautiful gardens.
parts: relax in our outdoor pool —— 在露天泳池放松
or walk around our beautiful gardens —— 或在花园里散步
ana.tip: 泳池和花园 —— 休闲向，Ethan 要的是训练。

paragraphs.s: Open Tuesday to Friday, plus weekends.
paragraphs.tr: 周二到周五开放，周末也开。

ana.frame: 省略句：Open Tuesday to Friday, plus weekends.
parts: Tuesday to Friday, plus weekends —— 周二到周五，外加周末
ana.tip: 每周只开到周五+周末 —— 不是「每天」（daily）。

paragraphs.s: We care about the environment, so please don't bring your car.
paragraphs.tr: 我们关心环境，所以请不要开车来。

ana.frame: 主谓宾 + 结果：We care about the environment, so please don't bring your car.
parts: so please don't bring your car —— 所以请不要开车来
clauses: so 引导结果
ana.tip: 不能开车来 —— 对 Ethan 来说多一条不方便。

paragraphs.s: There's nowhere better to get really fit.
paragraphs.tr: 想真正变健康，没有比这里更好的地方了。

ana.frame: 主系表：There's nowhere better to get really fit.
parts: There's nowhere better —— 没有更好的地方
to get really fit —— 来变得真正健康
gram: nowhere better 没有更好的地方
ana.tip: 口号式开头，重点在后面的设施和预订方式。

note.cn: 没有地方（nowhere better 没有更好的）

paragraphs.s: Gym membership costs just £20 per month and our squash courts can be reserved online.
paragraphs.tr: 健身房会员每月只要 20 英镑，我们的壁球场可以在线预订。

ana.frame: 并列句：Gym membership costs just £20 per month and our squash courts can be reserved online.
parts: costs just £20 per month —— 每月只要 20 英镑
our squash courts —— 我们的壁球场
can be reserved online —— 可以在线预订
clauses: 被动语态 be reserved
gram: be reserved online 在线预订
ana.tip: 会员费（定期付费）+ 在线预订 —— 正好对上 Ethan 的两个需求。

paragraphs.s: Lessons are available for most activities.
paragraphs.tr: 大多数活动都有课程可以上。

ana.frame: 主系表：Lessons are available for most activities.
parts: for most activities —— 对大多数活动
gram: be available for 可供……使用
ana.tip: 有课程 = Ethan 想「学一项新运动」能实现。

paragraphs.s: We open from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily; hot and cold drinks are available.
paragraphs.tr: 我们每天早 7 点到晚 10 点开放；有冷热饮供应。

ana.frame: 并列句：We open from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily; hot and cold drinks are available.
parts: open from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily —— 每天 7 点到 22 点开放
hot and cold drinks are available —— 有冷热饮供应
clauses: 分号连接两个分句
ana.tip: daily（每天）对应 Ethan 的 every day —— 答案 B 的证据齐了。

paragraphs.s: Eastpark has both outdoor and indoor pools, playing areas for football and rugby and a first-class gym.
paragraphs.tr: Eastpark 有室内外泳池、足球和橄榄球场地，还有一流的健身房。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：Eastpark has both outdoor and indoor pools …
parts: both outdoor and indoor pools, playing areas for football and rugby and a first-class gym —— 室内外泳池、运动场地和一流的健身房
clauses: both … and … 既……又……
ana.tip: 设施看着全，但要和 Ethan 的具体需求逐条比。

paragraphs.s: Facilities can be booked by phone only.
paragraphs.tr: 设施只能通过电话预订。

ana.frame: 被动句：Facilities can be booked by phone only.
clauses: 被动语态
ana.tip: only（只能）电话预订 —— 和 Ethan 的「用 email 预订」不符。

paragraphs.s: For students, we offer reduced prices for membership.
paragraphs.tr: 对学生，我们提供会员折扣价。

ana.frame: 主谓双宾：we offer reduced prices for membership.
ana.tip: 学生优惠 ≠ Ethan 的需求。

paragraphs.s: There are bus stops nearby and parking is free.
paragraphs.tr: 附近有公交站，停车免费。

ana.frame: 并列句：There are bus stops nearby and parking is free.
ana.tip: 交通方便 ≠ 训练、课程、在线预订 —— 逐条排除后答案 B。

paragraphs.s: For each question, choose the correct answer.
paragraphs.tr: 每题选出一个正确答案。

ana.frame: 祈使句：choose the correct answer（选出正确答案）
ana.tip: 正确答案 = 把人每个需求都满足的那一家。

paragraphs.s: The people below all want to visit a studio where films are made.
paragraphs.tr: 下面这些人全都想参观拍电影的制片厂。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：The people below all want to visit a studio where films are made.
parts: a studio where films are made —— 拍电影的制片厂
clauses: where 引导定语从句
ana.tip: 人物是「需求方」，制片厂文本是「供给方」。

paragraphs.s: On the next page there are descriptions of eight film studios that people can visit.
paragraphs.tr: 下一页有八家可供参观的电影制片厂的介绍。

ana.frame: 存在句：On the next page there are descriptions of eight film studios …
parts: On the next page —— 在下一页
descriptions of eight film studios —— 八家电影制片厂的介绍
that people can visit —— 人们可以参观的
clauses: that 引导定语从句
ana.tip: 八家 = A–H。

paragraphs.s: Decide which film studios would be the most suitable for the people below.
paragraphs.tr: 判断哪些制片厂最适合下面这些人。

ana.frame: 祈使句：Decide which film studios would be the most suitable for the people below.
parts: which film studios would be the most suitable —— 哪些制片厂最合适
for the people below —— 对下面这些人
clauses: which 引导宾语从句
ana.tip: 逐一核对：每个人的每个需求都要在文本里有对应。

paragraphs.s: Tom wants to look around the studio at his own speed, and visit the actual sets where films were made.
paragraphs.tr: Tom 想按自己的节奏参观制片厂，看看真正拍过电影的场景。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：Tom wants to look around the studio at his own speed, and visit the actual sets …
parts: at his own speed —— 按自己的速度
and visit the actual sets where films were made —— 看看真正拍过电影的场景
clauses: where 引导定语从句
gram: at one's own speed 按自己的速度
ana.tip: 关键词：own speed（自己逛）、actual sets（真实拍摄场景）。

note.cn: 自己的速度（at one's own speed 按某人自己的速度）

paragraphs.s: His mum wants to see online what the studio is like before she buys tickets.
paragraphs.tr: 他妈妈想在买票前先在网上看看这家制片厂什么样。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：His mum wants to see online what the studio is like before she buys tickets.
parts: what the studio is like —— 制片厂是什么样
before she buys tickets —— 在她买票之前
clauses: what 引导宾语从句；before 引导时间状语从句
ana.tip: 关键词：see online before buying（先网上看再买票）—— 找「有官网介绍」的那家。

paragraphs.s: Ingrid is interested in seeing costumes that famous actors have worn, and she'd also like to ride on a vehicle that originally appeared in a film.
paragraphs.tr: Ingrid 有兴趣看著名演员穿过的戏服，还想乘坐一辆真正在电影里出现过的车。
